threshold_selection.selection_rule: maximum symptomatic F1 subject to precision target; if infeasible, maximum unconstrained F1; ties precision, recall, higher threshold

limitations: Visible-symptom annotations do not establish laboratory diagnosis or absence of latent infection.
Synthetic horizontal blur/brightness/downscale tests are not real drone/video validation.
Independent fixed-threshold IoU0.5 metrics and native mAP measure different operating summaries.
A detection does not establish safe autonomous removal, grasping, cut location, navigation or economic savings.

clean.matching: confidence-descending greedy, one-to-one, class-aware after explicit remapping

healthy_mistaken_actions.definition: symptom predictions matched class-agnostically to all GT at IoU>=0.5; count matched healthy GT

clean.uncertainty_note: Wilson intervals treat pods as independent; same-tree/capture dependence can widen uncertainty.
